environment.description: Application deployed on EC2 instance behind a classic ELB (TCP passthrough mode) in a public subnet. Security group allows inbound 0.0.0.0/0 on port 8080. No additional middleware or proxy filtering. SQLite database contains production user records including email addresses and internal role assignments. Flask runs directly via gunicorn with no request filtering middleware.

config.load_balancer: Classic ELB, TCP listener on port 80 -> instance port 8080
config.network: Public subnet, IGW attached, no NACL restrictions beyond default
